name: coding-guides
description: Injects the user's standing coding conventions (tool-use, git, and skill-handling preferences) into every session via a SessionStart hook, and enforces select rules (e.g. single-line commit messages) via a PreToolUse hook. Ships a pi adapter that does the same from the same files, and a user-invoked /auto-deliver skill that hands the rest of a feature to the agent.
